title: Psalm 23
opening_line: The LORD’s my shepherd, I’ll not want.

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: The LORD’s my shepherd, I’ll not want.
text.normalized: The LORD’s my shepherd, I’ll not want.
text.reading: The LORD’s my shepherd, I’ll not want.

text.diplomatic: He makes me down to lie
text.normalized: He makes me down to lie
text.reading: He makes me down to lie

text.diplomatic: In pastures green: he leadeth me
text.normalized: In pastures green: he leadeth me
text.reading: In pastures green: he leadeth me

text.diplomatic: the quiet waters by.
text.normalized: The quiet waters by.
text.reading: the quiet waters by.

text.diplomatic: My soul he doth restore again;
text.normalized: My soul he doth restore again;
text.reading: My soul he doth restore again;

text.diplomatic: and me to walk doth make
text.normalized: And me to walk doth make
text.reading: and me to walk doth make

text.diplomatic: Within the paths of righteousness,
text.normalized: Within the paths of righteousness,
text.reading: Within the paths of righteousness,

text.diplomatic: ev’n for his own name’s sake.
text.normalized: Ev’n for his own name’s sake.
text.reading: ev’n for his own name’s sake.

text.diplomatic: Yea, though I walk in death’s dark vale,
text.normalized: Yea, though I walk in death’s dark vale,
text.reading: Yea, though I walk in death’s dark vale,

text.diplomatic: yet will I fear none ill:
text.normalized: Yet will I fear none ill:
text.reading: yet will I fear none ill:

text.diplomatic: For thou art with me; and thy rod
text.normalized: For thou art with me; and thy rod
text.reading: For thou art with me; and thy rod

text.diplomatic: and staff me comfort still.
text.normalized: And staff me comfort still.
text.reading: and staff me comfort still.

text.diplomatic: My table thou hast furnishèd
text.normalized: My table thou hast furnishèd
text.reading: My table thou hast furnishèd

text.diplomatic: in presence of my foes;
text.normalized: In presence of my foes;
text.reading: in presence of my foes;

text.diplomatic: My head thou dost with oil anoint,
text.normalized: My head thou dost with oil anoint,
text.reading: My head thou dost with oil anoint,

text.diplomatic: and my cup overflows.
text.normalized: And my cup overflows.
text.reading: and my cup overflows.

text.diplomatic: Goodness and mercy all my life
text.normalized: Goodness and mercy all my life
text.reading: Goodness and mercy all my life

text.diplomatic: shall surely follow me:
text.normalized: Shall surely follow me:
text.reading: shall surely follow me:

text.diplomatic: And in GOD’s house for evermore
text.normalized: And in GOD’s house for evermore
text.reading: And in GOD’s house for evermore

text.diplomatic: my dwelling-place shall be.
text.normalized: My dwelling-place shall be.
text.reading: my dwelling-place shall be.
